experiment_name: PROMOTION-scoped challenger gate for 032's frozen 96-game A_lr1e-4 checkpoint (candidate_ppo_80_lr_ablation_A_lr1e-4_96.pt) against the current 80-game champion PLUS the same 32/64/128-game opponent families 033 used, on fresh PROMOTION seeds disjoint from 033's

algorithm_config.purpose: 032's frozen 96-game A_lr1e-4 checkpoint beat the 80-game champion on 032's own DEV confirmation set only (single opponent, DEV seeds). This gate tests whether it also beats the 80-game champion directly and generalizes across the same 32/64/128-game opponent families 033 used, on fresh PROMOTION seeds never touched by 032 or 033.
algorithm_config.algorithm_frozen: PPOAgent, ActorNetwork/architecture, PPO hyperparameters, reward shaping, action space, state pipeline, evaluation_protocol.py's statistics, and the reference submodule were all unmodified - reuses 028/030/031/033's exact play_one_game/summarize wholesale (scripts/monopolyzero_pure_ppo_strength_screen.py), no new evaluation framework.
algorithm_config.design: For each of 20 fresh PROMOTION seeds (50020-50039, evaluation_protocol.SEED_CLASS_PROMOTION, disjoint from 033's consumed 50000-50019, verified via require_seed_scope before running): one challenger_96 focus seat + three copies of ONE opponent family, rotated across all 4 physical seats = 4 games/seed/family. Four opponent families (vs_80: the current 80-game champion; vs_32, vs_64, vs_128: identical to 033's already-verified checkpoints) x 20 seeds x 4 rotations = 320 physical games total, max_rounds=200, deterministic legal-masked argmax for every seat.

pre_registered_decision_rule.primary_statistic: aggregate challenger win rate across the four equally-weighted opponent families vs. the symmetric 25% null, via evaluation_protocol.seed_block_bootstrap_vs_null with the PROMOTION seed (not seat, not opponent family) as the resampling block - each seed block pools all 16 games (4 rotations x 4 families) sharing that seed
pre_registered_decision_rule.CHALLENGER_PROMOTION_GO: ALL three hold: (1) vs_80 family's 95% CI lower bound for (win_rate - 25%) is > 0; (2) aggregate 95% CI lower bound is > 0; (3) no individual family's CI upper bound is <= 0
pre_registered_decision_rule.CHALLENGER_PROMOTION_KILL_KEEP_80_GAME_C: vs_80 family's CI upper bound is <= 0, OR aggregate CI upper bound is <= 0
pre_registered_decision_rule.note: Behavior metrics (BUY_PROPERTY/ACCEPT_TRADE/DECLINE_TRADE rates), net worth, bankruptcy rate, and round-cap rate are diagnostic only, exactly as in every prior gate in this project - they are recorded but cannot override this rule (see docs/EXPERIMENTS.md's 034 pre-registration entry).

result: CHALLENGER_PROMOTION_GO per the pre-registered rule: vs_80 CI for (win_rate - 25%) = [+5.0, +32.5]pts (lower bound > 0); aggregate CI = [+18.125, +29.0625]pts (lower bound > 0); no individual family's CI upper bound <= 0 (worst case, vs_32, upper bound +26.25pts). Aggregate: 155/320 = 48.44% win rate. Per-family: vs_80 35/80=43.75% GO (CI [+5.0,+32.5]pts); vs_32 34/80=42.5% GO (CI [+8.75,+26.25]pts); vs_64 48/80=60.0% GO (CI [+26.25,+45.0]pts); vs_128 38/80=47.5% GO (CI [+12.5,+32.5]pts). All four families and the aggregate clear the pre-registered GO bar, including a direct win against the 80-game champion itself. 0 illegal actions, 0 crashes, 0 ASU modules loaded across all 320 games. Important limitation, diagnostic-only and non-overriding per the pre-registered rule: aggregate round-cap rate is 89.375% (most 'wins' are round-200 net-worth tiebreaks, not bankruptcy victories), and the challenger's BUY_PROPERTY and ACCEPT_TRADE rates when legal are both 0.0% (a known, previously-documented behavioral collapse also present in the prior 80-game champion). This result establishes strength within this project's existing self-play family (same-lineage checkpoints) on held-out PROMOTION seeds; it does not by itself establish generalization to a genuinely different opponent, an official competition engine, or an unverified turn/round horizon.
